ov: لحظة ضعف هو فيلم مصري من إنتاج سنة 1981، بطولة صلاح ذو الفقار ونيللي وحسين فهمي، من تأليف محمود أبو زيد وإخراج سيد طنطاوي.
plotEn: Abdul Ghaffar outrages against his wife, Saneya, when he discovers that Sahar is not his daughter, but rather as a result of a sinful relationship with Saneya before her marriage to him. To Egypt, it turns out that Abdul Ghaffar has assigned Sharif the task of returning Sahar after he regrets and is convinced that she is a victim, Sharif asks Abdul Ghaffar to keep his mission secret from Sahar and bless their marriage.
